responsibility: Declares the arithmetic-error setup helpers shared by COBOL code-generation routines. Its interface is intentionally small and focused: it exposes creation/initialization of label structures for arithmetic exception handling and compute-error status so genapi/genmath callers can attach COBOL ON SIZE ERROR style control flow around generated arithmetic operations.
same_name_distinction: Only declares the small arithmetic-exception setup helpers shared with other code-generation files; unlike genmath.cc, it does not implement arithmetic statement lowering or runtime-call selection.
